title: Why did last week's posts do well?
answer: Short how-to videos carried the week: post three more before Friday.
takeaway: The 4 how-to videos drew 58% of the week's views, against 31% in the 8 weeks before.

platforms.note: Connecting it would add long-form reviews.

figures.label: Posts
figures.comparison: the same as the week before

insights.text: Short how-to videos drew most of the week's views.
insights.evidence: 4 how-to videos had 58% of the views from 15 posts.
insights.so: Post three more how-to videos this week. The lift may fade once the holiday buying ends.

chart.title: Share of views by kind of post

insights.text: Posts that asked a question in the first line drew twice the comments.
insights.evidence: 5 posts with a question opener averaged 96 comments.
insights.so: Open the next three captions with a question about the build.

insights.text: TikTok posts went out at the wrong hour for this audience.
insights.evidence: 4 of 6 TikTok posts went live before 9 AM ET.
insights.comparison: the 2 evening posts drew 2.3 times the views
insights.so: Move TikTok posts to 6 to 8 PM ET for two weeks, then compare.

actions.object: three short how-to videos on Instagram and TikTok
actions.effect: Keep views at 1.3 times the median or more

actions.object: TikTok posts to 6 to 8 PM ET
actions.effect: 2 times the views per TikTok post in two weeks

gaps: Paid results: connecting the Meta ad account would show which posts were boosted.

confidence.why: 15 posts is a small week, so the how-to lift needs a second week to hold.

sources: Posts Atlas holds for @brightsidetoys on Instagram and TikTok, Sep 21 to Nov 22, 2026
